#### Grid Data Loading
```julia
# Now creates Vector{Point3f} and Point3{Int} for dimensions
function _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String)
    # ... read x, y, z from file
    xyz = Point3f.(x, y, z)
    n = Point3{Int}(nx, ny, nz)
    return xyz, n
end
```
